notes.title: Patch Notes for August 27th 2025
notes.content:
Removed all AI generated content from the game and replaced with real, existing artwork

Added new SFX to the Husk

Added reworked and improved SFX with reverb in the later sections of the game

Fixed a bug where, if you were reading a note and you got killed, the note would permanently stay on screen

Fixed a bug where you could pick up items from the safe without inputting the password

Fixed an issue where a door’s animation wasn’t properly synced up with the audio

Improved the mixing for several different sounds across the whole game

notes.title: Thank you.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're making this post to thank you. Thank you for the reviews, for buying the game, for playing and sharing your feedback, and for all the support.

It is surreal for us as a small indie team to have this much positivity on our first release. Here is a recap of everything that happened since we launched our title up until now:


 We sold over 1500 copies;
 Reached 5000+ wishlists;
 A "Very Positive" rating with 98% of total reviews being positive;
 We got Steam Deck verified!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/ccd845ca00aa7e9e028b0766e92b1141fd9ed4b6.png

And we're not done.

We are already working hard on our next project, set on a completely different world with totally different gameplay mechanics. We can't wait to show you what we've been working on, but for the time being, here's a sneak peek:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710980/ce1ecee8910597535ef4f3892e885b12720faf60.gif

To close it all out, thank you once more. We'll still do some minor updates on For Sale just to ensure the smoothest experience possible, but rest assured that most of our focus is now directed towards creating an amazing, original experience for you to enjoy.

Talk to you soon,
The Collarpill Team.

notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, thank you to all who wishlisted so far! We're almost at 1.000 wishlists (currently sitting at around 950) - your support means the world to us in this first release, so make sure to share with any friends you know that would be interested in the game.

Second of all, we've done some slight tweaks and decided to officially release the project on the 17th of January, 2025. This is because we want to ensure maximum visibility of the project, and releasing in December wouldn't be the best option for us due to the Holidays and Steam sales.

That extra time also helps us to market the project further and also polish the game as a whole to ensure to you a solid, consistent experience from start to finish.

Having said all that, see you in a couple of weeks! We're really excited to show you what we've been up to all this time...
